article.title: Correlation, Causation, and Confounding in Data Analysis

paragraphs.en: Correlation describes a pattern in which two variables change together, but causation makes a stronger claim: changing one factor would change an outcome. Customers who receive marketing messages may buy more frequently, yet this does not prove the messages caused additional purchases. The recipients may already have stronger purchase intentions. Analysts must distinguish observed differences from effects that would occur under an intervention. Otherwise, organizations may pay for campaigns that mainly reach people who were already likely to buy. Clear language about the distinction prevents a descriptive finding from becoming an unsupported business promise.
paragraphs.zh: 相關性描述兩個變數一起變動；因果性則主張改變一個因素會改變結果。收到行銷訊息的客戶可能較常購買，但這不證明訊息增加購買，因為收件者可能本來意願就高。分析師須區分觀察差異與介入效果，避免將描述性發現當成未經支持的商業承諾。
paragraphs.ja: 相関は二つの変数が一緒に動くことを示しますが、因果は一方を変えた場合の結果を意味します。配信先が元々購入意欲の高い人なら、配信効果と誤認する恐れがあります。

paragraphs.en: Imagine an online shop sending discounts only to recent website visitors. These customers show a higher purchase rate than nonrecipients. The company might attribute the entire difference to the promotion. However, recent browsing activity predicts both selection into the campaign and subsequent purchasing. This creates confounding: a third variable influences the supposed cause and the outcome. Comparing groups without considering that factor can exaggerate effectiveness. The challenge is especially serious when the campaign uses a predictive model to select high-propensity customers, because successful prediction does not by itself demonstrate incremental impact.
paragraphs.zh: 假設網店只向近期訪客發折扣，收件者購買率較高。公司可能把差異全歸因於促銷，但近期瀏覽同時影響被選入活動及後續購買，形成混雜。未處理這個第三因素會誇大效果。用預測模型選高購買傾向客戶時尤其重要：預測準確不代表增量影響。
paragraphs.ja: 最近の訪問者に割引を配ると購入率が高くても、閲覧履歴が配信選択と購買の両方に関係します。予測精度と増分効果は別です。

paragraphs.en: A causal diagram helps make assumptions explicit. Analysts can draw arrows from prior customer interest to campaign assignment and purchases, and another from the campaign to purchases. Such diagrams do not prove the relationships, but they clarify what must be measured and what remains uncertain. The timing of variables matters. A variable observed after treatment may itself be affected by the intervention. Controlling for it can remove part of the effect or introduce new bias. Therefore, adding every available column to a regression is not automatically a better causal strategy. Analysts should explain why each adjustment is justified.
paragraphs.zh: 因果圖能明確假設：先前興趣影響活動分派及購買，活動也可能影響購買。圖不證明關係，但能釐清測量需求與不確定性。處置後變數可能已受介入影響，控制它會移除部分效果或引入偏誤。因此迴歸加入所有欄位不一定較好，每個調整都應有理由。
paragraphs.ja: 因果図で仮定を明示します。処置後の変数を調整すると効果の一部を消したり偏りを生んだりするため、変数選択の理由が必要です。

paragraphs.en: Random assignment can reduce systematic differences between treatment and control groups. When implemented properly, the average outcome difference estimates the effect of assignment under the experimental conditions. Nevertheless, experiments still face practical problems. Missing outcomes, customers who do not follow their assigned treatment, interference between participants, and changes in data collection can weaken interpretation. Analysts should define the target population, observation window, outcome metric, and exclusion rules before examining results. If a campaign affects customers beyond those directly assigned, even the meaning of the estimated effect may require careful discussion.
paragraphs.zh: 隨機分派可降低處置與控制組間系統性差異。執行正確時，平均結果差異可估計實驗條件下分派效果。但結果缺失、不遵從、參與者互相影響與資料蒐集變動仍有問題。應事先定義目標族群、觀察期間、指標與排除規則。若活動影響未被直接分派者，效果定義也須重新討論。
paragraphs.ja: 無作為割付は群間の偏りを減らしますが、欠測、不遵守、参加者間の干渉、測定変更には注意が必要です。指標と期間は事前に定義します。

paragraphs.en: When randomized experiments are impossible, observational methods can still be informative. Matching, regression adjustment, difference-in-differences, and instrumental variables each rely on specific assumptions. A sophisticated statistical model cannot reconstruct information that was never collected. If an important confounder is entirely unobserved, the estimate may remain biased after adjustment. Sensitivity analysis asks how strong an omitted factor would need to be to overturn a conclusion. It is often better to report a qualified result with transparent limitations than to present a precise number whose credibility depends on hidden assumptions.
paragraphs.zh: 無法隨機實驗時，配對、迴歸、差異中的差異或工具變數仍可提供資訊，但各有假設。複雜模型不能補回從未收集的資訊。若重要混雜因素未觀測，調整後仍可能偏誤。敏感度分析評估遺漏因素要多強才會推翻結論。透明說明限制比隱藏假設的精確數字可靠。
paragraphs.ja: 観察研究の各手法には仮定があります。未観測の交絡があれば推定は偏るため、感度分析と限界の説明が必要です。

paragraphs.en: Communication should match the strength of evidence. Saying that recipients purchased more often describes an association. Saying that a campaign increased purchases makes a causal claim requiring stronger support. Analysts should report uncertainty, define the population to which findings apply, and distinguish the effect of receiving an offer from the effect of being assigned to receive one. Managers may still act under uncertainty, but they deserve to know which conclusions depend on assumptions. The goal is not to avoid causal questions; it is to answer them with methods and wording appropriate to the available data.
paragraphs.zh: 溝通措辭應符合證據強度。「收件者購買較多」描述關聯；「活動增加購買」是更強的因果主張。分析師應報告不確定性、適用族群，並區分實際收到優惠與被分派收到優惠的效果。管理者可在不確定下決策，但應知道哪些結論依賴假設。
paragraphs.ja: 『受信者の購入率が高い』は関連の記述で、『配信が購入を増やした』は因果主張です。推定対象と不確実性を示します。
